customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in the justfile, annotated with # renovate: comments.
The tflint AWS ruleset version, which has no manifest of its own.

packageRules.description: Group the shared reusable workflows, which release together. The hub releases daily and its pins are the only way this repo gets CI fixes, so the weekly Monday schedule and the PR, branch and hourly limits must not hold them back. Open first when limits do apply.
The Terraform version is pinned on both sides - the justfile and the CI setup step - so they must move together or one pin becomes a lie.
The AWS provider range in the shared modules is deliberately wide; only bump it for a major.
Hold TypeScript below 7: typescript-eslint rejects TS 7 at load time (https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940). Drop this rule when typescript-eslint supports it.
Dev tooling churns; batch it rather than one PR per bump.

Automerge everything short of a major once ci-success passes. ci-success is the required check on main and covers just check, every example's release bundle and a reproducible-build diff, so a bump that breaks anything never merges. Merges through GitHub auto-merge, so branch protection still decides.
Our own reusable workflows need no quarantine period.
